entity.name: Vaibhav Chhajer
entity.description: Mathematics researcher building Scriptavera, an open-source tool that turns handwritten research notes into faithful research papers.

projects.name: Scriptavera
projects.description: Turns handwritten research notes (scans or photos) into a LaTeX research paper in small, checked steps. The author confirms the notation, every doubtful reading and every figure, and a mechanical audit checks that every formula reaches the paper unchanged. Mathematics first; designed for any field.

channels.description: Write to arrange a grant or a donation; bank details are given on request.

plans.name: 12-Month Core Development and Indian University Pilot
plans.description: Full-time development of cryptographic priority timestamping (RFC 3161), multi-model proof verification routing, Lean 4 export hooks, and a 1-year free pilot across mathematics departments at IITs, NITs, IISc, IISERs, ISI, TIFR, and CMI.

plans.name: 6-Month Core Engineering and Benchmark Milestone
plans.description: Support for expanding handwritten mathematical transcription benchmarks, diagram reconstruction, and deterministic formula integrity auditing across LaTeX manuscripts.

plans.name: General development and maintenance
plans.description: Flexible grant or donation support for developing Scriptavera, extending it to new scientific fields, and keeping it maintained.
